description: Defines builder classes for constructing DL PDSCH PDUs and codewords, including setting parameters for transmission, codeword, and PDU configurations in 5G NR protocol.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_codeword_builder
classes.description: Builder for setting parameters of a DL PDSCH codeword, including basic and maintenance parameters.

classes.name: dl_pdsch_pdu_builder
classes.description: Builder for constructing and configuring a DL PDSCH PDU, including setting BWP, codewords, DMRS, resource allocation, and vendor-specific context.

methods.name: set_basic_parameters
methods.description: Sets fundamental parameters of a codeword such as code rate, modulation order, MCS, and TB size.

methods.name: set_maintenance_v3_parameters
methods.description: Sets maintenance version 3 parameters for a codeword.

methods.name: set_basic_parameters
methods.description: Sets basic parameters for the PDSCH PDU, including RNTI.

methods.name: set_bwp_parameters
methods.description: Configures bandwidth part parameters for the PDSCH PDU.

methods.name: add_codeword
methods.description: Adds a codeword to the PDU and returns a builder to set its parameters.

methods.name: set_codeword_information_parameters
methods.description: Configures codeword information such as NID, layers, transmission scheme, and reference point.

methods.name: set_dmrs_parameters
methods.description: Sets DMRS-related parameters for the PDSCH PDU.

methods.name: set_pdsch_allocation_in_frequency_type_0
methods.description: Configures frequency resource allocation type 0 for the PDSCH.

methods.name: set_pdsch_allocation_in_frequency_type_1
methods.description: Configures frequency resource allocation type 1 for the PDSCH.

methods.name: set_pdsch_allocation_in_time_parameters
methods.description: Sets time domain resource allocation for the PDSCH.

methods.name: set_ptrs_params
methods.description: Configures PTRS parameters for the PDSCH.

methods.name: set_profile_nr_tx_power_info_parameters
methods.description: Sets NR transmission power profile parameters.

methods.name: set_profile_sss_tx_power_info_parameters
methods.description: Sets SSS transmission power profile parameters.

methods.name: set_cbg_re_tx_ctrl_parameters
methods.description: Configures CBG retransmission control parameters.

methods.name: set_maintenance_v3_bwp_parameters
methods.description: Sets maintenance version 3 BWP parameters.

methods.name: set_maintenance_v3_codeword_parameters
methods.description: Sets maintenance version 3 codeword parameters.

methods.name: set_maintenance_v3_csi_rm_references
methods.description: Sets CSI-RS rate matching references.

methods.name: set_maintenance_v3_rm_references_parameters
methods.description: Sets rate matching reference parameters.

methods.name: set_maintenance_v3_cbg_tx_crtl_parameters
methods.description: Sets CBG retransmission control parameters.

methods.name: set_maintenance_v4_basic_parameters
methods.description: Configures maintenance version 4 basic parameters.

methods.name: set_context_vendor_specific
methods.description: Sets vendor-specific context for the PDSCH.

methods.name: get_tx_precoding_and_beamforming_pdu_builder
methods.description: Returns a builder for transmission precoding and beamforming configuration.
